name: route_approval_workflow
description: route_approval_workflow: Route a pending access or membership request to a manager for approval. Sends an approval notification and starts the 48-hour approval SLA clock.

request_id.description: The request ID to route for approval (e.g. REQ-SW-048271).

employee_id.description: The employee who made the request (e.g. EMP048271).

approver_employee_id.description: The manager who should approve the request (e.g. EMP031482).
